name: bijli-bill-explainer
description: Urdu-first web app that reads a photo of a Pakistani electricity bill and explains, line by line in plain Urdu, where the money went and why the bill went up.

paragraphs: Pakistani electricity bills are full of lines that even grown children struggle to explain to their parents: FPA, QTR, F.C. Surcharge, Electricity Duty, GST, and a units total that quietly crossed a slab. This Urdu-first web app takes a photo of the bill (K-Electric, LESCO, FESCO, IESCO, PEPCO and the other distribution companies) and explains, line by line in plain Urdu, where the money went and why the bill went up.
Screenshots show the app's built-in sample bill, which is made up and labelled as a sample.

The model's only job is transcription: amounts, units, the bill month and the monthly history table, each line mapped to one of 18 known keys (fpa, qta, fcsurcharge, gst…). The Urdu meaning of each line comes from a fixed dictionary (src/lib/dictionary.js). "Why did it go up?" is worked out by plain rules in src/lib/explain.js:
features: units compared with last month, from the bill's own history table;
crossing 200 units after six months below it (losing "protected" status);
a fuel price adjustment or quarterly adjustment of 5% of the bill or more,
taxes and surcharges that are 15% of the bill or more;
